usage: cli.py ingest-filings [-h] --ticker TICKER --start START --end END
                             --out OUT [--meta-out META_OUT]
                             [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] --user-agent USER_AGENT
                             [--cache-only] [--refresh] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ticker TICKER       Ticker symbol
  --start START         Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --end END             End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --out OUT             Output JSONL path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output metadata JSON path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory for SEC responses
  --user-agent USER_AGENT
                        SEC-compliant User-Agent with contact info
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not fetch.
  --refresh             Refresh cached data from provider.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
